# migration

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeMigration`](gmeow-eventTypeMigration.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeMigration>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

A relocation of people from one place to another — a family's move, an internal migration, or a multi-generational flow. The general movement event ([schema:MoveAction](https://schema.org/MoveAction)'s shape); immigration/emigration are its border-crossing specialisations.
